The 20 latest in this range
How these numbers are worked out
  • ASAP order: placed for as soon as possible (walk-ups, kiosk, truck QR, website “now”, delivery apps). Pre-order: placed for a later pickup time (events, scheduled, pickup slots).
  • Ticket time (ASAP only): placed → ready. Walk-ups count from the Square sale when it’s known.
  • Wait to start: placed → first item started. Cook time: first item started → ready. Pickup wait: ready → picked up.
  • On time: ASAP orders ready within the target above; pre-orders ready by their pickup time (2 minutes’ grace).
  • 90% within: nine in ten ASAP orders were ready within this time (the 90th percentile) — the number guests feel on a busy night.
  • Change arrows compare with the same length of time just before. Green = better, red = worse. Canceled and refunded orders are left out of times; orders left on the board for over 4 hours are left out of averages.

When it’s on
  • Website: the Platinum teaser in Rewards (blurred items, rotating hints), a locked “Secret Menu” row in the menu, and points-to-go for members. Platinum members see the Secret Menu first.
  • Drive-up: Platinum members (signed in or checked in) get the Secret Menu; other members see how many points to go.
  • Kiosk: after check-in, “Welcome back, insider” and the Secret Menu for Platinum; points to go for everyone else.
  • Kitchen: secret items carry a ✦ PLATINUM tag.

When it’s off, none of this shows anywhere and secret items can’t be ordered (a cart that still has one is refused politely). Points and Platinum status keep counting either way.

Square sales summary

Delivery apps (exempt)

DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub collect and pay Ohio sales tax on their orders, so their sales go under Exempt Sales. Courier tips are left out. Compare with each app’s monthly statement (subtotal before tax and tips).

How these numbers are worked out

  • Gross Sales = Square net sales (items + service charges − returns − discounts) minus “Tip” service charges. Sales tax and tips aren’t sales.
  • Exempt Sales = DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub sales (Ohio UST instructions, line 2: sales made through a marketplace facilitator that collected the tax).
  • Taxable = Gross − Exempt. Tax liability = Taxable × county rate. Pay at least the tax Square collected from customers.
  • Sales count in the month the payment was taken (Ohio time); refunds in the month they were made, as in Square’s report.
  • Ohio returns for a month are due on the 23rd of the next month. Not tax advice: ask your tax preparer if something looks off.

Sources: Ohio UST return instructions · Ohio restaurant sales tax guide

          Day by day

          How these numbers are worked out
          • Where the numbers come from: Square's own sales (every payment, its items, discounts, service charges, tax and tips, and every refund), copied into the portal within seconds. They match Square Dashboard → Reports → Sales summary. Website / QR / drive-up / event labels, customers and promo codes come from our order records.
          • Gross sales: items before discounts, plus service charges (online fee, card surcharge, tips added as a charge), as Square counts them. Discounts: promo codes, member rewards and POS discounts. Refunds: counted on the day they were made.
          • Net sales = gross sales − discounts − refunds. This is the main number, the same as Square uses.
          • Tax and tips are added on top; Collected = net sales + tax + tips: everything guests paid, minus refunds.
          • Average order = net sales ÷ orders. A sale paid in two parts counts as one order. Company-tab orders count when the company pays the bill.
          • New customer: their first order with us is in this period. Returning: they ordered before. Walk-up window sales usually have no name, so they aren't in the customer numbers.
          • Sales count when paid, Ohio time (the same as Square). Canceled and failed payments are left out.
          • Previous period is the same number of days right before. Same days last year is 52 weeks earlier, so weekdays line up.
